title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot. It shows a non-linear relationship between the amount of antibiotic and the number of colonies. The relationship appears to be decreasing rapidly at first and then leveling off.

title: Possible Transformations
text: Consider transformations that can linearize a decreasing curve. Common transformations include taking the logarithm or square root of the dependent variable.

title: Logarithmic Transformation
text: One possible transformation is to take the logarithm of the Colonies. This can help linearize the relationship if the data follows an exponential decay.

title: Square Root Transformation
text: Another transformation is to take the square root of the Colonies. This can help if the relationship is a power function.

title: Choosing the Right Transformation
text: Consider the shape of the curve. If it resembles an exponential decay, a logarithmic transformation might be more suitable. If it resembles a power function, a square root transformation might work better.
